hero.title: My name is Aylen Gil
hero.focus: Focused on frontend development with React and TypeScript

paragraphs: I'm a Fullstack Developer focused on frontend development, with experience working with React and TypeScript. Throughout my career in IT, I've worked across different areas, including development, QA, functional analysis, and integrations.
My experience has allowed me to understand different stages of the software development process and how a business need can be transformed into a technical solution.

I enjoy understanding how things work, bringing structure to information, and leaving each project clearer and more organized than I found it. That's why I care about writing clean code, applying good practices, and building systems that are easy to understand, maintain, and continue developing.
